Existing localization, privacy, no-nested-project-button, accessibility-audit, and ordinary-content bounds checks remain active after the repair.
limitations: This receipt is source verification only and provides no simulator, physical-device, signed-package, or external-service evidence.
The debug reentry harness exercises app-hosted runtime navigation; it is not evidence of WidgetKit delivery.
This source remains version 0.1.0 build 4; later version allocation or signed artifacts require their own exact-candidate evidence.
